findings.description: The condition `all(arg.help is not None for arg in args)` should be `any(...)`. It also evaluates to True when there are no positional arguments, so the section is written even when the command has none.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with no Argument params (common), or one where only some arguments have help. For the first case, `all()` over an empty list is True, so `formatter.section(_("Positional arguments"))` writes an empty heading. For the second, `all()` is False as soon as one argument lacks help, so the whole section is dropped, even though the docstring says the section is written 'if at least one is documented'. Mechanism: the guard tests for every argument having help rather than at least one. Impact: help output for many commands gains a spurious empty 'Positional arguments:' heading, and documented arguments disappear from help whenever any sibling argument is undocumented.
